rules: one complete primary beverage on the lower-right half of the round wooden table
one brownie plate above and slightly right of the beverage with a small relaxed gap
one dark rectangular brownie with irregular cream and cocoa, viewed almost vertically
one small reclaimed-wood teaspoon at plate two o'clock, handle upward and elongated oval bowl downward
partial bentwood cane chair enters from upper-left and remains secondary
same upper-left window-sun key and attached lower-right shadows for all objects
product edges inherit local wood bounce, grain-scale acuity and sensor texture without color contamination

container_modes.adopt_reference: use the declared unbranded warm-white paper cup; user beverage remains authoritative
container_modes.preserve_source: preserve broad source cup family and material plus visible source serviceware; rebuild projection, light and shadow under the preset camera
